mentions.name: quxnet
mentions.description: A retro-web social network that recreates the old internet as authentically as possible, taking inspiration from early messageboards, Usenet, BBSes, and pubnix hosts. It features sealed mail, discussion boards, an RSS reader, a built-in media player, custom profiles, and a links directory.
mentions.problem: Bringing back what was amazing about the old internet in an authentic way.
mentions.audience: Like-minded people looking for a calm space to talk on the old-web-style network
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://quxnet.net/about

I made it specifically to bring back what was amazing about the old internet, and do it as authentically as possible. takes inspiration from old internet messageboards, usenet, bbs, and pubnix hosts. it has sealed mail, boards, an rss reader, built-in media player, custom profiles, a links directory, and quite a bit more.
mentions.author: replwoacause
